coder_notes: Registered as PHASE4 (excluded at S3 by code) but coded in full. Inclusion requires GBM, but the post-surgical histology exclusion allows IDH-mutant astrocytoma grade 3 or 4 to remain, so the population may effectively be mixed glioma; coded gbm_only from inclusion/conditions. IDH row is a histology-defining criterion (excludes other histologies) rather than a strict IDH requirement. Both pembrolizumab arms are labelled ACTIVE_COMPARATOR; arm 3 (NO_INTERVENTION, Stupp only) is the control. Immuno-PET tracer is not a registered intervention but a protocol procedure (brief summary says all patients; detailed description says arms 1 and 2); listed as diagnostic agent. Target engagement: PD-L1 immuno-PET change correlated with T-cell activation markers. Radiotherapy is part of Stupp backbone in all arms.
